 Balasaheb Thackeray’s grandson actor Aaishvary Thackeray loses Rs 19,000 to cyber fraud
 City | TNN | Nov 3, 2026, 12:28 IST Aaishvary Thackeray reported fraudulent transactions in his bank account amounting to Rs 19,638.15.
 Save Comments Share MUMBAI: Aaishvary Thackeray, the grandson of Shiv Sena founder Balasaheb Thackeray, lodged a complaint with the police after fraudulent transactions occurred in his bank account. Oshiwara police have lodged an FIR and are probing further.
 Thackeray (30) worked as an assistant director on Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s Bajirao Mastani in 2015 and debuted as an actor in the Hindi film Nishaanchi last year.
 In his complaint, Thackeray stated that he lived with his mother, Smita, and grandmother, Kunda, in Andheri. On Oct 30, he was home when he received a text on his phone at 1.30 am. The text mentioned that a sum of Rs 307.82 had been deducted from his bank account. Eight minutes later, he received another text about Rs 15,511.98 being deducted from his bank account.
 According to the police, a total of six fraudulent transactions were made in his bank account and Rs 19,638.15 was fraudulently debited. Police said the transactions had been made overseas and they are investigating further. A case was registered against an unknown cyber fraudster under the provisions of Bhartiya Nyaya Sanhita and Information Technology Act.
